items.title: Disney’s environmental sustainability co-lead leaves company
items.summary: Yalmaz Siddiqui has exited his role as vice president of environmental sustainability at The Walt Disney as a result of a corporate reorganization, effective Oct. 17.

items.title: Labour says Jackdaw ‘compatible’ with net-zero goal as gas field project is approved
items.summary: Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh has approved the controversial Jackdaw project, in a move that will increase domestic gas production by up to 6%, while also establishing a new low-carbon energy fund based on tax revenues from North Sea projects.

items.title: Prologis UK hits certification milestone with new logistics unit
items.summary: Logistics real estate firm Prologis UK has reached a new milestone for sustainable development, with a new logistics unit at the Daventry International Rail Freight Terminal (DIRFT), becoming its 100th development to achieve Planet Mark certification.

items.title: ‘Overshoot is not surrender’: UN sets out route back to 1.5C
items.summary: Ahead of the 31st Climate Change Conference of the Parties (COP31), the UN has warned that rapid emissions cuts are needed to limit climate overshoot, and set out the approaches that need to be scaled to make this happen.

items.title: Report: Europe’s green investment tops €1.2trn, but funding gaps remain
items.summary: New research has found that European companies have invested more than €1.2trn in EU Taxonomy-aligned capital expenditure since 2023, but uneven investment across member states and a shortage of risk-bearing finance could hinder the next phase of the bloc’s green transition.

items.title: What does CBD COP17 need to deliver for nature-dependent businesses?
items.summary: A new survey has found that climate resilience is now the leading driver of corporate action on nature.

items.title: Heat costs global economy $3.9trn a year as MPs warn UK is unprepared
items.summary: Already, heat is estimated to cost the world almost $4trn a year in productivity losses, and with temperatures and wildfire risk on the rise, a new parliamentary report highlighted serious gaps in the UK's response capabilities.

items.title: MPs urge Government to speed up reforms to cut energy bills
items.summary: The Commons Energy Security and Net Zero (ESNZ) Committee has called on the UK Government to make a number of changes in order to bring down energy bills, including shifting policy costs off electricity and onto gas.

items.title: Electricity network investment could unlock £58bn for UK economy, industry plan finds
items.summary: Investment in Great Britain’s electricity networks could contribute £58bn to the UK economy, according to a new plan published by the Energy Networks Association (ENA) and BEAMA.

items.title: TOMORROW: The future cost of EV charging – what businesses can’t afford to overlook
items.summary: Join edie on 22 October for our 45-minute masterclass, 'The Future Cost of EV Charging,' delivered in partnership with Brook Green Supply.
